name: The Principal Source
summary: At Cliffspring Falls, a sickness among Darkshore's deer draws the Cenarion Circle's attention to the water. Dendrite Starblaze sends young druids from Moonglade to collect a sample for Auberdine naturalist Alanndarian Nightsong.

sections.title: A Vital Waterway Corrupted
sections.body: Cliffspring Falls feeds northern Darkshore with fresh water. When deer began to sicken with a lingering malady, the Cenarion Circle looked to the river for its cause. Dendrite Starblaze in Moonglade suspects the water source is tainted and sends novice druids to gather a sample at the cavern mouth beneath the falls.

sections.title: Shadows at the Falls
sections.body: Vicious naga dwell inside Cliffspring River Cave, near the falls' headwaters. Their presence threatens anyone trying to investigate the blight. The Cenarion Circle needs a sample from the cave mouth to study what is making the wilderness sick.

sections.title: A Deeper Malady
sections.body: In Auberdine, Alanndarian Nightsong finds the water sample confirms the Circle's fears. The corrupted falls are poisoning the riverbanks, but sick deer have also been seen beyond the water's direct path. The sample can help begin an antidote, while Alanndarian suspects a wider corruption is spreading through Darkshore's water table.

faq.q: Why is Cliffspring Falls so important to Darkshore?
faq.answer: Cliffspring Falls supplies fresh water to northern Darkshore. Its headwaters feed local streams and rivers, so contamination there can spread through the surrounding land and wildlife.

faq.q: Why are the deer in Darkshore falling ill?
faq.answer: The deer drink from Cliffspring Falls and the streams it feeds. The water is tainted at its source, and the pollutant is making the woodland creatures sick.
Dendrite Starblaze is an elder druid trainer in Moonglade. He guides young druids, watches for disturbances across Kalimdor, and coordinates the Cenarion Circle's response to natural crises.

Alanndarian Nightsong is a night elf naturalist in Auberdine. Concerned by the corruption and suffering wildlife in Darkshore, she asked the Cenarion Circle in Moonglade for aid studying the affliction and finding a cure.

faq.q: Why are naga at Cliffspring Falls?
faq.answer: Naga from the Darkshore coast have moved inland and occupied the cave system behind Cliffspring Falls. Their presence endangers anyone trying to reach the headwaters and investigate the water.

faq.q: What ability does this quest help druids learn?
faq.answer: The investigation is part of the Power over Poison trial. By studying the wildlife sickness and working with Alanndarian Nightsong on an antidote, druid initiates learn to cure poisons.

angles.text: As a druid, you face the decay at Cliffspring Falls and help prepare remedies. This trial teaches you the knowledge needed to cure poisons in the wild.
As a night elf of Auberdine, you see the corruption of Cliffspring Falls threaten your ancestral forests and the creatures that live there.
